angel-chasing-devil-roundel.description: The whole round miniature from the recto. A white-robed angel with a pale gold halo and dark red wings strides to the right holding a long thin gold staff diagonally, one hand reaching towards a black horned devil who runs off to the right while looking back at the angel; the devil is painted black with fine gold hatching. They stand on a yellow-green hillside with blue-green trees under a blue sky with a few gold streaks. A thin gold rim closes the scene. Opaque inside the rim, transparent outside.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Office of the Dead: Angel Chasing a Devil (recto)

angel-chasing-devil-roundel.quality: The gold rim is worn and chipped, with dark patches where the ground shows through.
angel-chasing-devil-roundel.title: Angel chasing a devil, roundel
usage_notes: Complete roundel with its own rim and painted ground; place it as a picture, not as a cut-out.
The figures alone are white-robed-winged-angel and black-horned-devil; the empty gold ring at the right of blue-gold-floral-frame is this roundel's seat.

bearded-profile-head.description: The head and shoulders of a man in left-facing profile with a large hooked nose, a pointed grey beard, long ochre-brown hair falling behind the ear and a gold hoop earring. The skin is pale with grey-blue shading and he wears a plain white collar. Cut from the recto text block; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Office of the Dead: Angel Chasing a Devil (recto)

bearded-profile-head.title: Bearded man's head in profile
usage_notes: Only the head and collar are kept; the initial it belongs to is not included.

black-horned-devil.description: A slender black devil with two straight horns and pointed ears strides to the right on long legs while its head turns back to the left in profile. The body, limbs and face are drawn in fine gold hatching over black; one arm is bent before the chest, the other stretched back, and a thin curved tail hangs between the legs. The feet end in claws. Cut from the recto roundel; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Office of the Dead: Angel Chasing a Devil (recto)

black-horned-devil.title: Running black devil looking back
usage_notes: Cut from angel-chasing-devil-in-gold-oval; pairs with white-robed-winged-angel at the same scale, placed to its left.

discs-and-diamonds-line-filler.description: A finite horizontal line filler from the verso, a burnished gold bar with a black outline carrying eight motifs that alternate blue and brown, each with fine gold hatching, from left to right a blue diamond, brown disc, blue diamond, brown disc, blue disc, brown disc, blue diamond and brown diamond. Only the painted bar is opaque; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Office of the Dead: Two Devils (verso)

discs-and-diamonds-line-filler.quality: A speck of a neighbouring gold dot remains just outside the lower left end of the bar.

usage_notes: Finite strip at a fixed length; for a band of any length use discs-and-diamonds-repeat-b, which carries the same motifs as a seamless tile.

The pattern continues across the left and right edges. Only the painted band is opaque; the thin strips above and below it are transparent.

The bar is slightly thicker at the left end than at the right. Only the painted bar is opaque; the background is transparent.

discs-and-three-diamonds-line-filler.quality: The outer edges of the bar are soft and slightly ragged as painted.

gold-foliate-wave-line-filler.description: A short finite horizontal line filler from the recto, a burnished gold bar with a black outline in which two curling acanthus leaves lie end to end in a wave, a brown and gold leaf on the left and a blue and gold leaf on the right, their lobes drawn in black line over gold. Only the painted bar is opaque; the background is transparent.

gold-foliate-wave-line-filler.title: Acanthus wave line filler

human-headed-bird.description: A grotesque bird walking to the right on two thin legs with spread claws. Its brown body carries a folded wing dotted with rows of yellow-gold spots, a pointed tail of three feathers to the left and a long curved neck ending in a pale bearded man's head with short brown hair, turned slightly towards the viewer. Cut from the lower margin of the recto border; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Office of the Dead: Angel Chasing a Devil (recto)

human-headed-bird.title: Walking bird with a bearded man's head
usage_notes: Cut from the lower margin of blue-gold-floral-frame; the verso has a second human-headed bird, human-headed-bird-with-gold-neck.

human-headed-bird-with-gold-neck.description: A grotesque bird lying with its brown body and pointed tail stretched to the right and a long gold neck curving up and over to the left, ending in a pale bearded man's head that hangs face down. The folded wing carries rows of yellow-gold spots and the gold neck is shaded with brown. Cut from the lower margin of the verso border; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Office of the Dead: Two Devils (verso)

human-headed-bird-with-gold-neck.title: Lying bird with a bearded man's head
usage_notes: Cut from the lower margin of blue-gold-floral-manuscript-frame; the recto has a walking counterpart, human-headed-bird.

recto-floral-border.description: The complete painted border of the verso, a dense field of hairline tendrils with gold dots, green and yellow leaves, blue and red flowers and red fruits, with large blue and gold acanthus scrolls in the four corners and along the top. The round miniature of two dancing black devils in a landscape sits in the left margin and a human-headed bird with a gold neck lies in the lower margin. The text block is framed by a thin brown and gold rule with a blue finial at each upper corner. The text block is transparent; the parchment between the sprigs is kept at partial opacity.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Office of the Dead: Two Devils (verso)

recto-floral-border.quality: Parchment between the sprigs is kept at partial alpha across the whole border, so it carries a faint cream haze on dark backgrounds.
recto-floral-border.title: Verso floral page border with devils roundel
usage_notes: Fixed page border, scaled as a whole with content placed in the transparent text block; it is not a border-image, the four sides and corners all differ.
The roundel and the bird are painted into the border and are also available alone as two-dancing-devils-in-gold-landscape-oval and human-headed-bird-with-gold-neck.
Reads best on a light ground because of the partially opaque parchment between the sprigs.

two-dancing-devils-roundel.description: The whole round miniature from the verso. Two black horned devils with fine gold hatching dance side by side facing right, the left one with hands clasped before the chest, the right one with one arm thrown out and a leg kicked up, their clawed feet meeting at the bottom. They stand on a yellow-green hillside with blue-green trees under a blue sky that carries a short white inscription and two gold streaks. A thin gold rim closes the scene. Opaque inside the rim, transparent outside.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Office of the Dead: Two Devils (verso)

two-dancing-devils-roundel.quality: A wedge of the page with a red flower, a gold dot and bare parchment remains at the lower left outside the rim; crop it away when the roundel is used alone.
two-dancing-devils-roundel.title: Two dancing devils, roundel
usage_notes: Complete roundel with its own rim and painted ground; place it as a picture, not as a cut-out.
The figures alone are two-dancing-horned-figures; the roundel is still in place in blue-gold-floral-manuscript-frame.

two-dancing-horned-figures.description: Two black devils with straight horns and pointed ears dance side by side facing right, drawn in fine gold hatching over black. The left one holds its clawed hands before its chest and steps forward; the right one throws one arm out to the right and lifts a bent leg, its other foot overlapping the first devil's foot so the pair forms one piece. Cut from the verso roundel; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Office of the Dead: Two Devils (verso)

two-dancing-horned-figures.quality: A small pale parchment patch remains at the left devil's muzzle.
two-dancing-horned-figures.title: Two dancing black devils
usage_notes: Cut from two-dancing-devils-in-gold-landscape-oval; the figures touch at the feet and are kept as one piece.

verso-floral-border.description: The complete painted border of the recto, a dense field of hairline tendrils with gold dots, green and yellow leaves, red and blue flowers and red fruits, with large blue and gold acanthus scrolls at the top centre, the upper right and both lower corners. A human-headed bird walks in the lower margin. The text block is framed by a thin brown and gold rule with a blue and a red finial at its upper corners; a thin gold ring at the right is the empty seat of the removed roundel. The text block, the ring's interior and the parchment between the sprigs are transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Office of the Dead: Angel Chasing a Devil (recto)

verso-floral-border.quality: The trimmed leaf edge runs as a thin dark line along the outer sides; flaked spots inside some leaves show parchment tone, and a sliver of blue sky remains inside the top of the empty ring.
verso-floral-border.title: Recto floral page border with empty roundel
usage_notes: Fixed page border, scaled as a whole with content placed in the transparent text block; it is not a border-image, the four sides and corners all differ and the text-block rule is not quite straight.
The roundel angel-chasing-devil-in-gold-oval fits back into the empty gold ring at the right; the bird in the lower margin is also available as human-headed-bird.

white-robed-winged-angel.description: An angel in a long white robe stands turned to the right, head in three-quarter view with fair hair and a halo kept only as a thin gold line, two long dark red wings with gold speckling rising behind the shoulders. A thin gold staff with a small knob runs diagonally from the upper left across the body to the lower right; the right hand is raised before the chest and the left arm reaches forward. Cut from the recto roundel; the background is transparent.

provenance.object_title: Leaf from a Book of Hours: Office of the Dead: Angel Chasing a Devil (recto)

white-robed-winged-angel.quality: Soft mask edge all round; the halo survives only as a thin gold outline.
white-robed-winged-angel.title: Angel with a gold staff
usage_notes: Cut from angel-chasing-devil-in-gold-oval; pairs with black-horned-devil at the same scale, placed to its right.
